= SemanticTripWiki =
A Semantic MediaWiki for the documentation of trips as ordered legs between locations, set up with [https://github.com/WolfgangFahl/SemanticTripWiki SemanticTripWiki], see [https://wiki.bitplan.com/index.php/SemanticTripWiki SemanticTripWiki on wiki.bitplan.com].
